t: Will harvest nearby crops and leave the produce on the ground. It operates in a 4 block radius around it's home hive which can be increased with range upgrades. If you have a mod that adds right click harvest, the bee will do exactly that.
会收获附近的作物，并把产物留在地上。它会以自己的蜂巢为中心，在 4 格半径内工作，这个范围可以通过升级：范围提升。如果你安装了支持右键收获的模组，这种蜜蜂也会这样做。
